speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue. To better assist you, may I ask if these symptoms have been present for more than two weeks, and have you noticed any unintentional weight loss or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent hiking and camping, have you noticed any insect bites, mosquito exposure, or been in a swampy area? Additionally, have you developed a rash, joint pain, or muscle aches alongside your fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain to rule out structural causes; CT Chest to evaluate for thymoma.

REQUEST TEST: Anti-AChR antibodies, Anti-MuSK antibodies, and Creatine Kinase (CK).
